body.statement: On the submodel \(e(x)=1/2\) and \(\eta(y\mid x)=q_1(y)\), the experiment contains an independent Bernoulli half-sample from \(Q_1\), and the minimax expected \(W_1\) risk over the corresponding positive Hölder-density benchmark is of order \(r_{\mathrm{or},n}(m,s)\) for \(m\ge3\). Thus every claimed frontier must reproduce the Niles-Weed--Berthet direct-sample rate exponent when confounding and covariate variation vanish.
body.justification: This reduction is the mandatory sanity check for the phase diagram and pins the baseline that rough nuisances may or may not exceed.
body.gap: NilesWeedBerthet2022 proves the direct-sample rate over positive Besov density classes; the proposition requires the same exponent on the present classical Hölder benchmark and embeds that direct experiment as a randomized no-covariate-variation submodel.
body.consumer: It certifies that the known-design correction does not lose rate when the benchmark experiment becomes an oracle generation problem.
